title: Stock Market Breeze
description: You are analyzing a series of daily stock price fluctuations represented by an array of integers. For each day, determine how many days you would have to wait until a higher price is recorded. If no future day has a higher price, put 0 instead.
input_format: An array of integers representing daily stock prices.
output_format: An array of integers where each element represents the number of days to wait for a higher price.

examples.explanation: For day 0 (73), the next warmer day is day 1 (74), wait 1 day. For day 2 (75), wait 4 days until 76.
Each day's price is strictly less than the next, so the wait is always 1 day except the last.
Day 0 waits 1 day, Day 1 waits 1 day, Day 2 has no higher price.
